results.answer: If an employee suspects a security incident, they should report it immediately to IT Security rather than attempting to resolve it themselves. This can be done through the incident hotline or the #security-incident channel. Early reporting is preferred over delayed reporting, even if the suspicion turns out to be a false alarm. Additionally, any suspicious activity, such as a suspicious email, an unexpected password reset request, or a lost device, should be reported to IT Security immediately rather than investigated independently. If the employee notices unusual behavior like a service being unreachable, they should report it in the #ops-incidents channel, even if unsure whether it qualifies as an incident [DOC-012], [DOC-015], [DOC-024].
